## da7aac74dddc

**Perfect area shortcut: shape comparison is unnecessary.** The intended rule
marks two components equivalent when their cropped shapes match under rotation.
The generator creates each rotation class with a distinct cell count:

```python
sizes = rng.sample(range(2, 6), n_classes)
```

Objects in the same class share one base and therefore one area; objects in
different classes are forced to have different areas. Consequently the simpler
rule

> output `2` iff the two components have equal area; otherwise output `3`

is exactly equivalent on every generated input, without comparing shape or
rotation.

A census of 25,600 generated grids checked 290,380 ordered off-diagonal
component pairs. Area equality matched true rotational equivalence on
**290,380/290,380 pairs**; there were zero same-area, rotation-inequivalent
pairs. The canonical examples also preserve this shortcut: their component
areas are `(4,4,5)`, `(5,5,4)`, `(5,5,7)`, `(5,5,7)`, and test `(4,4,8)`.

A legal counterexample is a four-cell square and a four-cell T tetromino. They
have equal area but are not rotation-equivalent, so their matrix entry must be
`3`. The current generator cannot produce two different classes of the same
size. Sampling shape classes independently of area, while explicitly including
same-area negative pairs, would close the shortcut.

## da7aac74dddc

**Source binding:** generator SHA-256 `9f5ea2df11a543655ba6cf320535b8b018b7291492ea9c0ef61696fbb420c757`; executed rule hash `1891c8dc4643`.

**Reproduced shortcut.** The generator assigns distinct cell counts to distinct rotation classes, so “two objects are rotation-equivalent iff they have the same area” matched **2,000/2,000** validator-passing generated examples across four bands and seeds 90000–90499 (1,500 unique inputs).

The retained validator-valid counterexample places an L tromino and an I tromino, both area 3. Canonical Racket output is `[[1,3],[3,1]]`; the area-only rival outputs `[[1,2],[2,1]]`. This is inside the documented/validated domain and directly demonstrates that generated data omits equal-area, rotation-inequivalent negatives.

Evidence: `checks/audit/da7aac74dddc/shortcut-census.json`, `checks/audit/da7aac74dddc/input.json`, and `checks/audit/da7aac74dddc/racket.json`.

**Additional reproduced audit failure.** No task-local tests were found and the strict semantic gate reports no declared teaching contract. Evidence: `checks/audit/da7aac74dddc-combined/result.json`.

**Disposition:** actionable audit finding; no fix applied.
